basic-html.description: A static web page: HTML and CSS files imported as text and served by path, styled with Pico.

files.index.html:
Hi there!

I'm your new web page. Edit index.html, style.css and client/main.ts.

It is … where you are.

chat.description: A multi-turn chat: the browser keeps the history and POSTs it to /api/chat, which streams the reply back as text.

mailbox.description: A mailbox: mail to <applet>@<domain> lands in `inbox`, and the page sends mail from the same address. Turn email on in the applet's settings.

preact-app.description: A single-page app: a Hono API on the server, and a Preact page with UnoCSS utility classes in the browser.

sql-form.description: SQL: a contact form whose submissions land in the applet's own SQLite, listed back on the same page.
